notes: PvP Pad v3 on Robinhood Chain (4663): every launch is a fast Spireth game; all payments are in ETH. Fresh deployment of the accepted v3 implementation based on launch 1715 at cf4835d5388d5025c282a3cc59426fd730eaf88f. Deploy these five applications atomically in constructor dependency order, with zero ETH and no post-deployment initialization calls. PadToken() and PadGame() are sealed templates: deployment creates no token supply, token name or symbol, game clone, hook, pool or distributor. PvPPad(owner, tokenTemplate, gameTemplate) is the registry, clone factory, carry pot and open switch; its privileged owner is $owner. PadLiquidity(poolManager, pad) binds to the earlier PvPPad in its constructor; its inherited PoolManager address is 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951. KingOfThePad(pad, liquidity, dev) binds to both earlier applications; startGenesis() only completes the binding during construction. The explicitly specified dev recipient, 0x5b95a971b4583a5f011e9da082acdd679b870d06, receives 25% of crown extras; 50% funds games and 25% funds the PVP burn bucket. Constructors are nonpayable and call nothing outside the manifest, including neither the PoolManager nor ArbSys. The pad remains closed after deployment. Later openPad(salt), callable by the owner or anyone after 30 days, creates PadHook and the genesis token/game clones; every token, including PVP, is created later by the pad. PadHook is not a manifest application. Crown bids and fee distribution reject an unlocked PoolManager using the vendored v4 Lock transient slot. A crown transition requires the full 5M settlement stipend plus reserve and settles up to 16 pool indexes before replacing the king; any unflagged collection failure reverts the bid. Pools flagged broken after three failed collections in distinct L2 blocks are skipped and permissionlessly retryable. Collected ETH fees use a gas-capped push with claimable fallback; token fees transfer directly to the outgoing king without fee-token sales or stashes. Before the first crown, fees remain in positions. Rolls retain the 60-second cooldown and expiry penalty: 90% curve, 7% pot, 2% PVP burn (genesis: pot), 1% resolver tip, claimable by the direct or upkeep resolver; expired tips go to the pot. Resolution batches are gas-bounded and capped at 16. The first 0.001 ETH entry fee stays in the game as a once-only seed-capture bounty; other entry fees fund the burn bucket. Draw commits never recommit: lapsed hashes use keccak256(abi.encode(game, commit block, entry count)). Every optional upkeep sub-call has an explicit gas cap and caller reserve. Carry stays in PvPPad until finalization, when a game with at least five living Imps may pull only its unused fundedReleaseCap(); king funding and unreleased funded ETH retain the v2 rules. fundCarry is permissionless. The real v4-core suite, audit regressions, gas report and explorer verification guidance are in the accepted project. An independent audit is required before public launch. No deployment, broadcast or RPC calls are part of this manifest assignment.
